# Style 1: Red

> welcome in.

**The feel:** a warm, friendly, slightly humorous indie-filmmaker channel.

Start with [`overview.png`](overview.png) (everything on one sheet) and the brand guide in [`01_Brand-Guide/`](01_Brand-Guide/).

## Colours

| | Name | HEX | RGB | Share of a layout |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| signature | Brick Red | `#C23A3A` | 194, 58, 58 | about 70 % |
| light | Cream Pink | `#F4E3DA` | 244, 227, 218 | about 20 % |
| dark | Warm Black | `#1A1210` | 26, 18, 16 | about 10 % |

## Type

- **Anton** (Regular) for the name, titles and big lines.
- **DM Sans** (Regular, Medium, Bold) for small labels and anything you read.
- Both are free for commercial use. See `../fonts.md`.

## Sound

Warm analogue thuds, soft vinyl crackle, gentle tape hiss and a friendly low chime. Every intro ends on the two-note ASTRIS motif, in this style's voice.

## Rules

- Red is the field, cream is the lettering, warm black is for small type and dark versions.
- Use the cream, never pure white: white on this red looks cold.
- One red only: no tints, no gradients, no second accent colour.
